Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Wesley Matthews?

Wesley Matthews is 39 years old.

Where was Wesley Matthews born?

Wesley Matthews was born in San Antonio, Texas.

When was Wesley Matthews born?

Wesley Matthews was born on October 14, 1986.

How tall is Wesley Matthews?

Wesley Matthews is 6-5 (196 cm) tall.

How much did Wesley Matthews weigh when playing?

Wesley Matthews weighed 220 lbs (99 kg) when playing.

Is Wesley Matthews in the Hall of Fame?

Wesley Matthews is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position did Wesley Matthews play?

Shooting Guard and Small Forward.

When did Wesley Matthews retire?

Wesley Matthews last played in 2024.

What is Wesley Matthews' net worth?

Wesley Matthews made at least $115,730,643 playing professional basketball.

How much did Wesley Matthews make?

Wesley Matthews made $18,622,514 in 2019.

What did Wesley Matthews average?

Wesley Matthews averaged 11.4 points, 2.8 rebounds, and 1.9 assists per game.

How many rings does Wesley Matthews have?

Wesley Matthews won 0 championships.

What is Wesley Matthews' Instagram account?

Wesley Matthews is on Instagram at wessywes23.

What schools did Wesley Matthews attend?

Wesley Matthews attended Phillips Memorial in Madison, Wisconsin and Marquette.

What are Wesley Matthews' nicknames?

Iron Man is a nickname for Wesley Matthews.
